title: Chavi bar Nanai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Yevamot 115b mentions two documents produced in Mechoza, bearing the names Chavi bar Nanai and Nanai bar Chavi, on which Rabbah bar Avuha authorized collection. Hyman criticizes the author of Melo HaRoim for copying the name in Beit Vaad LaChakhamim as Chavi bar Yanai of Nehardea. He does not count Chavi among the Torah scholars.

notes.text: The court’s collection ruling does not by itself make Chavi a scholar; Hyman expressly rejects that classification. The alleged copied name changes both Nanai to Yanai and Mechoza to Nehardea.
The consulted Yevamot 115b reads Rava bar Avuha, whereas Hyman’s supplied text reads Rabbah bar Avuha. The collection ruling and the two document names are present in that passage.
